flaw_identified: Raw Kaggle archive has casing mismatches ('Apple'/'Banana' in train vs 'apple'/'banana' in test) and a spelling typo ('stawberries' in test vs 'strawberries' in train). When unnormalized, naive scripts falsely create 11 or 12 classes or report 0 test samples for 3 categories. Normalizing casing and mapping 'stawberries' -> 'strawberry' correctly restores the genuine 10 balanced fruit categories.
